1. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __between non-adjacent tissue layers__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain __other than creating the path or expanding the device__.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is an instrument __for performing a surgical procedure distinct from device insertion or expansion__.

3. (Original) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __in a location selected to avoid major blood vessels and critical neural structures__.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain __while maintaining hemostasis at the path__.

7. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __wherein the medical element is introduced after the device has been fully expanded and reinforced__.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is an instrument __for performing a therapeutic or diagnostic procedure__.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the reinforced working channel__.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __that are initially in contact with each other__.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue __while maintaining structural integrity of the tissue__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __during or immediately after device removal__.

13. (Currently Amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __selected from the group consisting of drug delivery, tissue sampling, and ablation__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is an instrument __configured for performing a procedure distinct from device deployment__.

15. (Original) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __in a predetermined anatomical location__.

17. (Original) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
